programmes.d: Sabrina competes with Gem for office of Class President. They play dirty until Gem accuses her of being weird. Sabrina goes to disastrous lengths to prove her wrong.

Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Someone is vandalizing the school. Meanwhile, Kasimir is behaving VERY strangely towards everyone, including Gus and Verne. A rift begins to form between them to the point that Gus would rather hang with the twins than Kasimir.
Guest teacher Master wizard Valentine dazzles the students with his wizardry. And after class he entices Cassy and Gus with tales of the Tear of Moolana.
Verne is picked on by Borge and Lucrezia when they see him playing a handheld video game.
A nervous Verne flunks his compulsory Scootsoomer driving test because he's afraid of heights. But he manages to conquer his fear at the Centre of the Earth on a wild ride.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
Marshall and Simon are startled by a creepy kid who's living in an old mill that's haunted by the ghost of Eerie's worst bank robber ever.
Trickery makes Marshall the new Harvest King, and he finds the king's traditional task no treat: he must venture to see the Eerie Wolf, which turns out to be a werewolf.
Marshall and Simon must really use their heads to crack open the real story behind a homeless man who seems to have lost his mind.
Something very strange pops up when Simon, Dash, and Marshall try to crack the inner sanctum of Eerie's odd and exclusive lodge.
Junior High School friends Stephanie and Jan hate rules.
Evan Wagner will do anything to get out of doing his homework, including lie to his teacher.
Richard and his younger brother Stephen, are willing to try anything to design the winning Science Fair project.
Best friends Derek and Rob love new things.
Sabrina’s cauldron blows up and splatters Cassandra with purplescent slime.
Sabrina is obsessing over the whole romantic triangle thing with Harvey and Cassandra.
Sabrina’s move to high school with its more demanding physical education classes has forced her to dash from the showers to her next class with her hair a disaster.
Sabrina is given cafeteria work for two weeks (all students rotate through). She’s cramming for a big test coming up
Down in the Netherworld, anticipation is building for a witch-specific holiday (like our Valentine’s Day or Halloween – like Mardi Gras, with everyone wearing masks).
Using typical teenage bad judgment, Sabrina starts repeating a rumor she has heard from Tiffany & Margaux. It’s a fairly hurtful sort of rumor about one of their classmates.
The gang is met with traps set by Merci on their way to confront Doji. When Gingka makes it, Doji asks him to join forces with him.
Gingka battles his long lost nemesis Ryuga - but his anger gets in the way of winning.
Through flashback, we learn about Gingka's father, Ryo, who originally had the bey Pegasus and was defeated by Ryuga and lightning L-Drago.
The gang set out to find Gingka in his home town but are faced with challenges along the way, including a mysterious traveler named Hyoma.
On their way to Gingka's village, the gang is tested by Hyoma who reveals he is an old friend of Gingka's.
Gingka climbs a mountain to obtain a scroll that may have the key to his defeating Ryuga.

'The Inspector....NOT!': The inspector and the Panther must capture a criminal before the guests at the Cheese Ball are robbed. 'Pink Links': An job penthouse-sitting lands the Panther in the midst of a rivalry between two women golf professionals.

'Panthergeist': The Panther is assigned to remove a fastidious ghost from a castle. 'Pinky's Pending Pink Slip': The Panther has to think up new ways to teach biology to a problem student without the Principal catching him breaking the rules.

'The Three Pink Porkers': The Panther's bed and breakfast is besieged by a trio of pigs that go hog-wild. 'The Heart of Pinkness': The Panther must make sure one of his river boat passengers isn't eaten by the legendary Varkzan of the jungle.

A dog food company holds auditions for a new mascot and Charlie thinks he's their dog, but it's Itchy who gets the job. As Charlie grumbles about his so-called partner stealing his job, Itchy's fame as the 'Gulp Dog' grows to a fever pitch.

Sasha wants a romantic dog, but Charlie argues that she'd be bored and that she should just accept Charlie for what he is! When a runaway bus nearly hits Sasha, Charlie takes the hit for her, and when he comes to, he's super-attentive.

Charlie suddenly finds himself leading the good life when Annabelle mysteriously assigns he and Itchy to help Carface and Killer at a meat packing plant. But is Annabelle really herself? And will Charlie see the light of goodness?

Charlie needs a vacation. Despite concerns, Charlie convinces Itchy to go with him. The road to leaving however, is not easy. So many terrible things happen that Charlie cannot walk a single city block without having to act as a Guardian Angel.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.
Sabrina's band, the Flavor Babes, use a little magic to launch their careers. The much desired fame and riches end up tearing Sabrina, Chloe, Hilda and Zelda apart.
When Pi sees Sabrina's Uncle Zamboni flying through the air he is convinced there are paranormal rumblings in Greendale. He makes it his mission to prove it to the townspeople.
Sabrina is tired of the restrictions that come with being a kid. She casts a spell that catapults into adulthood.

The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
